selection.summary: Evidence for notification dropdown and fork/move category-selector dropup issues in NodeBB v4.4.3. Includes: threadTools.js line 211 assigning dropup class based on viewport position (h0, h14); parallel postTools.js dropup handling (h1, h13); move.js and merge.js modal category selector handling (h5, h11, h15, h16, h26, h27); notifications client loading and dropdown toggle code in header/notifications.js and modules/notifications.js (h2, h6, h10, h17-h25); CHANGELOG entries noting the added dropup handler and post tools changes (h3, h12). These cover the reported async notification refresh/toggle race and mispositioned dropup menus in fork/move modals.
